summary: L10 OPS-01 + 'Terisi di Rak' review. Backend: new tests/test_l10_ops01_t1.py (8 tests: binned_rolls vs unassigned/orphan, missing-recount validation/authz, write-off full chain, foreign same/other warehouse, unknown-code new roll validation/403/qty override/no duplicates, 3 probes) + regression test_l10_ln101_roll_count.py (4) + test_l10_t1_review.py (12) = 24/24 pass. Frontend: ?view=wms-locations shows lp-kpi-occupied 'Terisi di Rak' = 18555 roll (= binned_rolls; Belum Ditempatkan 4582, Alamat Yatim 3 separate). ?view=operations > Stock Opname > session: roll-missing-recount -> state 'dihitung ulang oleh ...'; unknown-roll-form (product/owner/qty) + reason/zero-cost -> finalize -> missing 'dihapus dari stok (50 yard)', unknown 'roll baru RL-46500' (qty 6 override), foreign 'diterapkan' (relocated in DB), roll-policy text shown, status Disetujui. DB verified (consumed/0, new roll qty 6 in scan bin, 2 journals missing:/found:). Two real logic gaps found by probes (see critical).

critical.issue: DEADLOCK: a missing roll that was recounted and then had its qty changed in place (same bin, physical status, e.g. a cut/adjustment) can never be finalized. reconcile() still lists it as missing (only checks bin/status/len>0), but write_off_missing CASes on snapshot qty e['qty'] -> 'recount' every time -> session stays open forever with recount=[roll]. The UI message says 'scan ulang' but a missing roll cannot be scanned, and there is no way to clear the recount mark. Reproduced: probe test_probe_missing_changed_qty_after_recount (r1 & r2 both status open, recount ['TEST-..-7']). Fix: in reconcile treat live qty != snapshot qty as moved_after_cutoff (or CAS on live qty captured at recount time and write off live qty), and/or allow an un-recount/exception path.

A missing roll that is committed/reserved (status 'committed', length_reserved=5, allocated to SO) is written off silently: status->consumed, length 0, but length_reserved/allocation left dangling and SO not notified. apply_scan already blocks active_movement/length_reserved for relocation; write-off has no such guard. Should become exception (e.g. missing_allocated) or release allocation explicitly. Reproduced by test_probe_missing_committed_roll (200 approved, roll consumed, reserved 5).

minor.issue: Found roll is created via create_inbound_roll with lot='' -> _lot_for_segment attaches it to an EXISTING segment lot (observed: joined legacy lot KSC/LOT-2610-0001, dye_lot 'LOT-001', batch 'BATCH-001', and in another run joined a lot created by a previous opname session). Unknown-origin roll gets genealogy/dye-lot of unrelated rolls (shade-mismatch risk). Consider a dedicated new lot (source cycle_count_found) per session.

create_found_roll exception (no reference cost & no zero_cost_reason) is counted under roll_exceptions.relocation_blocked (misleading key) and session still closes — unknown code can then never be resolved. Better: validate upfront (400) before claiming, like product/qty checks.
new_rolls specs whose scan_id is not an unknown line are silently ignored (no 400).

issues: After finalize, unknown row 'Fisik' column shows scanned measured_qty (5) while the created roll has override qty 6 — show created qty in Penerapan (e.g. 'roll baru RL-46500 · 6 yard').
Foreign row shows only 'diterapkan' — show 'dipindah ke <bin>' so the relocation is visible.
Session list card shows '0 item' for roll-mode sessions (counts items, not scans).
Unknown-roll qty input at right edge is partly covered by floating 'Bantuan & Panduan' button at 1920 width.
Putaway tab badge 'Putaway (500)' capped while KPI Belum Ditempatkan = 4582 — label as 500+ or real count.
Unit order differs between KPI subtitles (yard·kg vs kg·yard).

action_items: Fix missing-roll write-off deadlock when roll qty changed in place after recount (reconcile should classify qty change as moved_after_cutoff, or write off live qty with CAS captured at recount).
Guard write_off_missing for committed/reserved/picked/packed rolls or length_reserved>0 / active_movement -> exception instead of silent consume (or release allocation + notify).
Found roll should get its own lot (not join existing segment lot / LOT-001 dye lot).
Validate missing zero_cost_reason for found rolls before claiming; use a proper exception key.
Minor UI: show created qty and relocation target in Penerapan column.

rca of the issue: Deadlock: reconcile() 'gone' test omits qty; write_off_missing CAS includes length_remaining==snapshot qty. A recounted missing roll whose qty changed remains 'missing' yet always fails CAS -> recount list non-empty -> _saga.release and status open on every finalize. Repro: snapshot bin with roll R(40) -> scan others -> roll-missing-recount R -> set R.length_remaining=35 -> roll-finalize twice -> both status open, recount=[R].
